evidence.fact: Leka Halasima is out with an ankle injury and is expected to be available for week one of the finals.
Taine Tuaupiki is the Warriors fullback in the final selection state; Charnze Nicoll-Klokstad is on the wing and Adam Pompey is at centre.
Te Maire Martin and Chanel Harris-Tavita return in the halves; Wayde Egan and Kurt Capewell are rested.
Manly retained its game-day starting side with no material late starting-side change identified.
Warriors $1.34, Sea Eagles $3.27; Warriors -9.5 at $1.82, Sea Eagles +9.5 at $1.99; total 49.5.
Near kickoff Auckland was about 16°C and mostly sunny; 5 pm local forecast precipitation probability 0%.

player_effects.reason: OUT; late backline reshuffle remains the main personnel negative.
Starts at fullback as part of the reshuffle.
Senior backline quality returns, but current role differs from earlier checkpoint reporting.
First-choice playmaking availability restored after hamstring injury.
Halves combination restored after hamstring injury.
Primary attacking threat remains in unchanged starting side.

team_macro_effects.Warriors: Strong season/home baseline and restored halves are counterweighted by deliberate finals-management rotation and a late backline reshuffle.
team_macro_effects.Sea Eagles: Out of finals contention but enter with starting-side continuity and strong recent attacking form; spoiler risk remains material.

matchup_effects: Warriors retain the stronger baseline and home advantage.
Manly continuity contrasts with Warriors personnel rotation, limiting confidence rather than reversing the selection.
Dry, mild conditions provide no evidenced weather mechanism requiring a tip change.
conflicts: Earlier checkpoint placed Nicoll-Klokstad at centre; final selection state places him on the wing with Adam Pompey at centre.
Warriors strong baseline/market favouritism versus meaningful rotation and Manly late-season attacking form.

weather.limitations: No reliable contemporaneous ground/surface report captured; wind/gust/humidity were not available in the weather source used for this freeze.

information_advantage_candidates.signal: Halasima withdrawal and consequent backline reshuffle
information_advantage_candidates.reason: Decision-relevant and captured before kickoff, but no evidence in this freeze establishes that MAYHEM obtained it before market absorption.
Useful integrity correction, but no demonstrated independent decision advantage.

frozen_decision.rationale: No new T-10 evidence is strong enough to reverse the Warriors selection or alter the already-reduced 68% confidence. The market remains strongly aligned with Warriors; dry conditions are neutral; rotation and backline disruption remain the principal counterweights.
